subject: general
question:
Select the option that does NOT belong to the same category as the others:

Amazon, Nile, Mississippi, Sahara
solution: The logic followed here is: **All options should belong to the same category — Rivers** Amazon → One of the longest rivers in the world (South America) Nile → One of the longest rivers in the world (Africa)
